text: You need a photo ID to vote in person in California.
seenIn: a TikTok about how to vote

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: What to Bring to Your Polling Place
truthSource.oneLine: In most cases California voters don’t show ID at the polls. Some first-time voters who registered without a license or SSN number may be asked for one, and a utility bill counts.

lesson.tip: Voter ID rules differ by state, and a ballot proposal isn’t the rule in effect. A video that’s right about one state gets shared as if it covers yours. Check sos.ca.gov for what applies here, now.
